title: Posets of trek polynomials for directed trees
summary: When a variety $V_\varphi$ equals the image of a polynomial map $\varphi$ whose coordinate functions are combinatorial generating polynomials (i.e.~polynomials enumerating combinatorial objects), the geometry of $V_\varphi$ reflects identities satisfied by the generating polynomials. The resulting interplay between combinatorics and algebraic geometry can be used to answer questions about $V_\varphi$.
